name: Navy (Vargr)
description: This career includes all members of an interstellar navy that patrols space between the stars. The navy is responsible for protecting society from foreign powers and the lawless elements within their own territories.

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.description: You serve as a pilot of a shuttle, fighter or other vessel.

crew.name: Crew
crew.description: You serve as one of the crew specialising in communications, gunnery, navigation or sensors.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.description: You serve as an engineer, mechanic or technician.

mishaps.1: Severely injured in action. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: You compete with another pack member for power and respect. Gain a Rival.
mishaps.3: Your pack fails to defeat an enemy or corsair band. Lose SOC −1 and gain the opponent as an Enemy.
mishaps.4: You make a critical mistake in battle causing your ship to be disabled. Lose SOC −1 and you are dismissed from service.
mishaps.5: There is a power struggle in your pack and you support the losing side. Roll SOC 8+. If you fail, you suffer DM-2 to your next Advancement roll and must leave this career.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You are given a special assignment onboard ship. Gain DM+1 to any Benefit roll for this career.
events.4: You help out a member of the crew. Gain a Contact.
events.5: Your time aboard spacecraft has made you proficient in the space environment. Gain one level in Vacc Suit or Athletics (Dexterity).
events.6: You are given advanced training. Roll EDU 8+ to gain one level in any skill you are eligible for in this career.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: You have become an experienced space hand. Gain one level in Astrogation, Electronics or Pilot.
events.9: You have learned to adapt to a variety of situations during your time in space. Gain Jack-of-All-Trades 1.
events.10: Your leader is killed and you attempt to take command of the unit. Roll SOC 8+. If you succeed, you become the pack leader and gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.11: Your exemplary performance earns respect from your leader. Gain DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: Your quick thinking and actions save your ship from destruction. You are automatically promoted and gain SOC +1.

7.benefit: Ship's Boat or Two Ship Shares
